# fabric_workspace_onelake_immutability_policy (Data Source)

The Workspace OneLake Immutability Policy data-source allows you to retrieve details about a Fabric [Workspace OneLake Immutability Policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/core/onelake-settings/modify-immutability-policy).

-> This data-source supports Service Principal authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fabric_workspace_onelake_immutability_policy" "example" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  scope        = "DiagnosticLogs"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) The scope of the immutability policy. Currently, only `DiagnosticLogs` is supported. Value must be one of : `DiagnosticLogs`.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `retention_days` (Number) The number of days that diagnostic logs remain immutable. The API does not allow reducing this value. Value must be between 1 and 2147483647.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
